doctrine: Lab receipts are EVIDENCE: never re-measured here, never invented.
A digest of a file that is not shipped proves nothing to a reader without it -- every row records contained_in_evidence_commit.
Three separate columns, never inferred from one another: model-legal window, machine-qualified window, episode-policy cap.
APPEND-ONLY. Every receipt-producing commit bumps manifest_version and appends its rows; rows are never rewritten in place.

admission_unenforced.ltx_8gb: admission NOT enforced: no cost row. The 'NO measurement of any kind on this box' that made its low/high marker provisional is CLOSED by lane 8 (2026-08-11): 9,106 MB absolute / 6,835 MB net, cold, at 512x288x161 in 22.1 s, a VramPeakProbe maximum. That qualifies the `low` MARKER; it is still not a cost row, and nothing refuses an over-budget plan on this lane today. Note what the number does NOT say: 6.8 GiB net is not a promise that the lane fits an 8 GB card, which is the exact claim the retired `8gb` token made without evidence.

admission_unenforced.ltx25_video: admission NOT enforced: no cost row and no envelope key. This lane loads the 16 GB mix4x8 DiT with the w4a8 encoder pinned to CPU -- the same weights as ltx25_native_foley_16gb, which rendered a 97-frame clip in 205.3 s on an RTX 5080 Laptop -- but a clip timing is not a qualified cost row, and nothing refuses an over-budget plan on this lane today.
admission_unenforced.minimax_h3_audio_in: admission NOT enforced: no cost row and no envelope key, exactly as its silent sibling. What gates this lane is its BOOT -- it requires the named h3 contract (sage-free, pinned memory off, --reserve-vram 12) and refuses by name at preflight otherwise. The lane's own manifest entry records a COLD 864x480 model-f124 ref2va leg at 7.20 GiB and a seed-43 lip-sync leg at 6.88 GiB, but a receipt is not a qualified cost row: nothing on this lane refuses an over-budget PLAN, and its receipts must not imply one.
admission_unenforced.minimax_h3_video: admission NOT enforced: no cost row and no envelope key. What DOES gate this lane is its boot -- it requires the named h3 contract (sage-free, pinned memory off, --reserve-vram 12) and refuses by name at preflight when the running server was started without it. That is where the 14.5 GiB outcome is actually decided here: every passing H3 leg on this box held the reserve clamp, and the one leg without it peaked 15.39 GiB on a SMALLER canvas. A boot refusal is not a per-beat admission check, so nothing on this lane refuses an over-budget PLAN and its receipts must not imply one.
admission_unenforced.animatediff15_v3_haunted_video: Admission is NOT enforced: the operator declined a measurement campaign; no qualified cost row exists, so this lane may fail OOM and makes no VRAM-fit claim. It carries a THIRD artifact (the 97 MB v3 domain adapter) on top of its parent's two, which is a real but unmeasured addition to resident weights.
admission_unenforced.animatediff15_v3_stillin_lab_video: Admission is NOT enforced: the still-in LAB PEER (2026-09-02) inherits its parent's artifacts and its parent's unmeasured cost; no qualified cost row exists, so this lane may fit or refuse only at render, never by an estimate. It is a lab id on the 5080 probe profile alone; the G8 solo smoke receipts its VRAM peak before any promotion.
admission_unenforced.animatediff15_lightning_video: Admission is NOT enforced: the LIGHTNING SPEED PEER (2026-09-08) inherits the family's unmeasured cost, so no qualified cost row exists and this lane may fit or refuse only at render, never by an estimate. Two things are worth stating rather than inheriting. FIRST, it carries three artifacts (the SD1.5 checkpoint, a 908,929,664-byte distilled module, and -- since 2026-09-09 -- the 334,641,190-byte MIT-licensed vae-ft-mse-840000 external decoder, which REPLACES the checkpoint's own VAE rather than sitting beside it). The distilled module is about half the size of mm-p_0.5, so resident weights remain lower here than on any sibling, which is a direction, not a number, and is not a VRAM-fit claim. SECOND, the lane exists to answer a TIME budget rather than a memory one: AnimateDiff was measured on an Apple M4/16GB at 122-134 s/it, which at the golden 20 steps and cfg 8.0 is 40 UNet passes and roughly three quarters of an hour per beat. Nothing in this manifest measures wall clock, so the 8-pass recipe's speedup is PREDICTED from pass count and is unproven until a clip lands in otr/obs/ with a receipt. Its device_backends row says cuda only for exactly that reason.
admission_unenforced.razzle_ltx_8gb: admission NOT enforced: inherits ltx_8gb's unmeasured cost row. Same 0.9.8 distilled 2B weights, same 512x288x161 canvas, same session recipe; only the raised razzle motion clause differs. Lane 8 measured ltx_8gb at 9,106 MB absolute / 6,835 MB net, cold -- that qualifies the sibling's low marker, not this id, and nothing refuses an over-budget plan on either lane today.
